title: Barbed Arrow
summary: Fire one arrow as an Action up to 60 ft for weapon damage. The target makes a DC 12 Dexterity save against Ruptured for 5 turns.

fields.Ruptured: Normal movement deals 1d4 Piercing per 3 ft and reduces duration by one turn each time. Jumping, teleporting and forced movement do not trigger it. The source reports the save can still occur on a miss.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
